stemMd: A rectangular poster has area $A$ and width $w$. A border of width $b$ is added outside all sides. What is the new area?
explanationMd: The original height is $A/w$. Each dimension gains b at both ends, hence 2b. Multiply the enlarged dimensions; lengths cannot be added directly to an area.

distractorRationale.d: Counts a border on only one end of each dimension.
distractorRationale.b: Adds lengths to an area without accounting for strips and corners.
